title_cn: 特朗普的司法部“武器化基金”、国税局豁免协议解释
summary: The deal President Donald Trump struck with the US Justice Department in May to end his $10 billion lawsuit against the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) featured two unusual arrangements.

title: Trump Fuels Hopes of Hormuz Opening With Hints Deal Is Close
title_cn: 特朗普暗示协议已接近，点燃了霍尔木兹开放的希望
summary:
US President Donald Trump said a deal on the Strait of Hormuz is possible as early as Wednesday, with talks with Iran "moving along very nicely".
The US, Iran and Oman are preparing to announce a 60-day agreement on shipping through Hormuz, under which inbound vessels would use a northern lane near Iran and outbound traffic would travel through Omani waters. Bloomberg's Michelle Jamrisko joins Bloomberg Intelligence to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: El-Sayed Fuels Progressive Momentum With Michigan Primary Win
title_cn: 埃尔-赛义德在密歇根州初选获胜，推动进步势头
summary: Abdul El-Sayed won the Democratic US Senate primary in Michigan, notching a narrow but cataclysmic victory over Representative Haley Stevens and the establishment wing of the party that backed her in the battleground state.
